title: AEGIS Finding
description: A record on the epistemic ladder: observation -> hypothesis -> confirmed -> rejected. Promotion and rejection both require evidence. A confirmed finding without reproduction is a contract violation.

status.description: The epistemic ladder. Transitions require evidence (see allOf guards below).

anchors.description: Precise locations: file:line, function symbol, firmware offset, endpoint path.

severity.description: Null until confirmed. Severity must be justified via severity_justification.

severity_justification.description: Checkable argument from the cited evidence to the assigned severity.

claim.description: Required for hypothesis/confirmed/rejected: the specific weakness claimed or refuted.

rationale.description: Why the hypothesis is plausible (required for hypothesis status).

verification_plan.description: How this hypothesis will be confirmed or refuted (required for hypothesis status).

evidence.description: Artifact IDs supporting the current status. Evidence for rejections is preserved here too.

reproduction.description: Numbered, machine-checkable reproduction steps. Required for confirmed status.

root_cause.description: Required before a confirmed finding is final.

mitigation.description: Validated mitigation. Required before a confirmed finding is final.

lessons_learned.description: What this finding teaches the platform. Feeds graph Lesson nodes (Improve/Evolve).
